purpose: Prospective liquidity-only confirmatory design; requires owner acceptance, development power gate and elapsed data before test activation

calendar.basis: verified cash sessions; no assumed holidays or fixed civil end date
calendar.start_rule: First approved cash session after method, identity, retention and power-design freeze; never backdate
calendar.activation_rule: Do not activate untouched test before development power assessment is accepted; if insufficient, version a new design before any test outcomes are inspected

information_cutoff.late_input_policy: Exclude and count; no substitution with later fetch or later restored file
information_cutoff.ready_rule: Source response, query completion, complete snapshot and persisted manifest all precede cutoff

method.price_signal_policy: excluded until contractual cash-flow/event windows are verified
method.rate_signal_policy: excluded until observed REUNE rates and conventions are available

identity_gate.eligibility_selection: Documentary validity, historical availability and liquidity only; never predictive outcomes
identity_gate.new_issuer_policy: No silent replacement or sample change after freeze

label_policy.first_archive_cutoff: 10:00 America/Sao_Paulo on first verified cash session after exit
label_policy.late_label_policy: Exclude from tuning/evaluation until actually archived; never treat reference date as known_at
label_policy.later_revision_policy: Keep original immutable labels; report separately frozen revision sensitivity, never overwrite
label_policy.feature_policy: Features/alpha/beta remain from information-cutoff snapshot; no refit with future labels

power_design.input_requirement: Chronological nested rolling-origin out-of-sample paired losses on development data only; training, tuning and label-availability purges enforced
power_design.resampling: Crossed full-CNPJ and non-circular calendar-block resampling on actual observation mask, retaining missing activity and overlapping horizons
power_design.interpretation: Conditional loss-test sensitivity, not end-to-end learning power; model-training uncertainty and source sparsity require separate calibration
power_design.failure_rule: If losses, dependence blocks, calibration or coverage are insufficient, report not_estimable; no minimum detectable gain or test activation

production.projection_basis: Executed recovery peak 400982016 allocated bytes / 64 newly recovered sessions x 302; scenario only, excludes staging, snapshots/WAL/backups and future source variation

revision_reason: Version 2 allows at most 34 delayed-horizon-20 nested development OOS dates before test; the unchanged floor is 60 and needs at least 166 perfect-coverage development references. Candidate 120/60 supplies 180, giving a best-case ceiling of 74, not power assurance.
